outputSource.note: outputs[spellId]: the item the recipe's one base-difficulty (DifficultyID 0) CREATE_ITEM (Effect 24) effect makes. minimum and maximum are its EffectBasePointsF only when that is a positive whole number with Variance, EffectRealPointsPerLevel, EffectPointsPerResource and EffectBonusCoefficient 0, no legacy EffectDieSides, no other scaling, and no disagreeing legacy EffectBasePoints; null means unavailable, not one. A recipe with no base-difficulty create effect, or with several, has no entry. cooldownMs: the larger of RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime in SpellCooldowns at DifficultyID 0, when positive; null means none recorded in these files, not proof there is none (encrypted blocks and server changes are not in them).
